issues.issue: Whether the claimant's ELN threats and cousin's case are credible
issues.applicant_position: Says ELN guerrillas phoned to recruit him and threatened him because he refused, after his cousin was targeted.
issues.result_quote: undermines the credibility of the claimant's claim that his fear of persecution was due to him being targeted by the ELN

issues.issue: Whether failing to claim protection in Spain and the United States undermines subjective fear
issues.applicant_position: Gave reasons for not claiming in Spain (lost passport, minor status) and the US (lengthy process, illegal entry).
issues.result_quote: the failure to claim in Spain or during the six years that the claimant was in the United States undermines the claimant's subjective fear

issues.issue: Whether the claimant has a subjective fear and a well-founded fear of persecution in Colombia
issues.applicant_position: Says he fears persecution by the ELN in Colombia for his refusal to cooperate with them.
issues.result_quote: the claimant is not credible with respect to the subjective component of his fear of persecution in Colombia

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a section 97 risk to life or of cruel treatment on return
issues.applicant_position: Says he would face a risk to life or cruel and unusual punishment in Colombia.
issues.result_quote: The panel does not find that the claimant has a foundation for establishing that he would be personally subject to a risk under Section 97 of the Act.
